name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Sunlighten is a sauna brand dedicated to improving people’s health and wellness. Aaron and Connie Zack founded the company in 1999 with a desire to help people achieve their wellness goals and achieve a healthy lifestyle. Inspired by the healing benefits experienced by Connie’s brother who overcame a decade of illness by regularly infrared sauna use, Sunlighten take pride in their range of therapeutic saunas.



Sunlighten’s premier sauna suite is the mPulse 3-in-1® Infrared, a home sauna suit that’s simple to use. This clinically backed sauna is the ultimate full spectrum sauna suit design with near, mid and far infrared sauna technology. Full health and wellness benefits can easily be gained by using the pre-set health programs. This innovative model also comes with customizable heaters and an easy to use LCD touch-screen control panel.



In addition to the flagship mPulse 3-in-1® Infrared Sauna, Sunlighten also sell their signature Far Infrared Saunas which are clinically proven to target weight loss and lower blood pressure. Sunlighten also offer community saunas and Portable Infrared Saunas to help everyone maximise wellness, health benefits and weight loss.
